critical_code_review_comments: conftest.py auto-injects X-Admin-Token into every requests call from inside /app/backend/tests. This is convenient for happy-path testing but makes 'unauth must 401' and 'PM-only-token must 403 on admin endpoints' tests FALSE-PASS unless the test explicitly overrides X-Admin-Token to empty string. iter35 test file documents this and overrides correctly — main agent should be aware that older test files may be silently passing admin-token auth they don't realize they have. Consider adding an opt-in fixture instead of always-on.

GET /api/admin/jobs only includes co_pm_emails key in jobs that actually have co-PMs (omitted-when-empty pattern). Frontend AdminJobMasterPanel must default to empty array on read to avoid undefined errors — verify in the component (likely already correct since job 24-06 renders).

Auto-email preview shape: {to: [primary], cc: [co_pms..., always_cc...], all_recipients: [merged], always_cc: [...]} — the always_cc list is duplicated under cc, which is harmless but the preview UI should use all_recipients (deduped) for display.

Note: in /api/auto-email/preview response for kind=inspection on 24-06, jaymn.judd@mascigc.com appears TWICE in cc (once as co-PM email, once as ALWAYS_CC). all_recipients dedups it correctly, but the cc array does not. Cosmetic only — final email transport (Resend) will dedup again. Cleanup is a small win in pm_routing.py.
